title: Momcozy BM01 Baby Monitor with 2 Cameras, 5'' 1080P Split Screen & no WiFi
bullets: 【Screen split screen】You deserve peace instead of guesswork, you can take care of 2 babies or 2 different scenes at the same time through the split screen function of the 5-inch large display screen, and you can get peace of mind just by looking at the screen.

【1080P HD & 360°field of view】 High-definition camera and 360°field of view, the monitor automatically cycles between two views, allowing you to fully cover the baby's environment, enjoy a movie-like viewing experience, and take care of your baby easily.

【5000mAh Long Battery Life】 The battery lasts all night. Even with the most frequent checks, the battery life can be as long as 11.5 hours. Don't worry about missing your baby's news because of insufficient power.

【No need for Wifi & App】 Monitor and Camera use 2.4GHz FHSS connection, which means that no hacker can access your camera through the Internet. Our baby monitors operate on a closed-loop system, giving you a secure and private connection that only you can hear and see.
【Ideal Gift】- The Momcozy Video Baby Monitor is an ideal gift for expecting mothers, new parents to watch over babies, pets or the elderly.
